name: How do I choose the right style of trim and molding for my home?
description: Choose trim and molding based on your home's architectural style and your personal taste for a cohesive look.

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right style of trim and molding for my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Consider your home's architectural style and your personal aesthetic. Traditional homes often suit elaborate, multi-layered crown moldings and wider baseboards, while modern homes may benefit from simpler, cleaner lines. Consistency throughout the home helps create a cohesive look. Visiting showrooms or viewing online galleries can provide inspiration.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose trim and molding based on your home's architectural style and your personal taste for a cohesive look.
